title: Grade Band Classifier
description: Read an integer exam score from 0 to 100 and print its band: DISTINCTION when score >= 85, MERIT when score >= 65, PASS when score >= 50, otherwise FAIL. Every boundary is inclusive: a score of exactly 85 is DISTINCTION and exactly 50 is PASS. The branches must be checked from the highest threshold down so each score lands in exactly one band. This problem establishes the C2 base skill of conditionals and boolean logic.
output_format: A single line: DISTINCTION, MERIT, PASS, or FAIL.
